about: Verified. Cannot pay everything today. Says he paid the credit card's overdue amount in full in the app on Saturday. For the personal loan says the full amount is too much right now, and if asked how much he can pay says 'you tell me'; accepts the lower amount when the agent offers it, and says he can pay it this Friday. For the car loan says 'end of the month, when my salary comes'; when asked for the exact day says he does not know; accepts the date the agent then proposes. Confirms the read-back.
